description:
This is the old access road used to support the fire lookout tower. The trail is 6.35km long with a gradual grade until the last pitch which is above treeline.

This is a motorized trail in snow free months only, care must be taken to remain on the designated trail at all times.
directions:
From Wells follow Hwy 26 to the Bowron Lake Road, follow the Bowron Lake Road for approximately 17.5km to the 2400 Road. Turn left onto the 2400rd and travel 5km.

The trail is on the left, with minimal parking along the 2400rd edge.
title: Two Sisters Lookout Trail
